name: a-half-claimed-pair-starts-nothing
find:
let busy = state.regeneratingDays(for: eventID)
        guard days.allSatisfy({ !busy.contains($0) }) else { return false }
replace:
let busy = state.regeneratingDays(for: eventID)
        if false { _ = busy }
breaks: a pair claimed for one shared write is granted while one of the two days is already rebuilding, so that day gets a second run and the other is left claimed by a caller that never started (#728)
